params.body:
Closes #1120

**Before merging:** change the queue worker in Forge (Daemons) so it listens on `photos` first. After the merge, uploads go to the `photos` queue, and a worker that does not listen there processes no upload at all. Listening on a queue that is still empty does no harm, so change the daemon first and merge after.

Current command on the box:

```
php8.5 /home/forge/traders.stocklistdealer.eu/current/artisan queue:work database --sleep=3 --daemon --quiet --timeout=300 --tries=3 --queue=default,webhook --force
```

New, only `--queue` changes:

```
php8.5 /home/forge/traders.stocklistdealer.eu/current/artisan queue:work database --sleep=3 --daemon --quiet --timeout=300 --tries=3 --queue=photos,default,webhook --force
```

Check with `ps -eo args | grep "[q]ueue:work"`.

## What was wrong

On 2026-11-25 a garage uploaded 95 photos to two vehicles. Every tile stayed grey on "processing takes longer than expected" for 8 to 14 minutes. Nothing failed: the queue was empty again by 11:12 and `failed_jobs` had nothing in three days. The uploads were waiting.

Production runs one worker, and every job is on `default`: own uploads (`ProcessVehiclePhoto`), platform copies, cut-outs and blur. From 10:33 to past 11:06 that worker made platform copies at a steady seven to eight a minute, one vehicle after another. Each upload waited for every copy queued before it. Once a batch of uploads came up, all 45 were done within about a minute.

An upload is a few seconds of resizing the dealer sits and waits for. A copy or a cut-out calls an outside service for seconds each, and nobody watches it happen.

## What changes

- `ProcessVehiclePhoto` goes on its own queue, `photos` (`ProcessVehiclePhoto::QUEUE`).
- CUTOVER.md section 4 gives the worker command as `--queue=photos,default,webhook` and says why `photos` comes first.
- R S1-6.36 records the queue and the case.
- Outside production the queue is `sync`, so staging and the preview do not change.

Not changed: the copies and cut-outs themselves. Making them faster, or a second worker, would also help, but each costs memory or money; this change only reorders who goes first.

## Tests

- `AnUploadIsNotQueuedBehindCopiesTest`: an upload through the dropzone is pushed on `photos`, and the worker command in CUTOVER.md lists `photos`, `default`, `webhook` in that order. Both fail on main.
- Full suite: 3315 tests green, PHPStan clean on the touched files.

Source: Portal mail:68 (forwarded by the office, with screenshots).
params.title: A dealer's upload has its own queue, taken before the platform copies
